title: Grateful Dead Live at Crisler Arena - University of Michigan on 1989-04-06
lineage: Master Cassettes (Maxell MX90 Metal) Tascam 112 -> Korg MR-1, @ 1bit 2.8MHz -> USB -> Korg Audio Gate Software 24bit 48KHz -> Wave Lab 5.0 w/UAD ->  r8brain PRO for Sample Rate Conversion 16/44.1KHz -> Traders Little Helper flac8
source: Nakamichi CM-100 mics with CP-4 shotgun caps -> Sony D-5

ai_review.summary: Awesome sound with solid Brown Eyed Women and Space, overall a good but unexceptional show
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its awesome sound quality, making it a pleasure to listen to. Musically the concert is decent, highlighted by strong performances of Brown Eyed Women and Space, though it lacks extraordinary improvisations. Fans of Built to Last will appreciate this well‑done rendition.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewer gave 4 stars overall; sound quality is highlighted as excellent while the performance is described as merely good, leading to a solid but not outstanding rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound quality praised as awesome with no reported issues; clarity and mix appear very good.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall a solid set with decent flow, but lacking the wild licks or surprises that make a show legendary.
